**SDD artifact reader: vendored marked lexer behind an inert tree (#1198)**

What: the drawer's SDD tab now renders all seven SDD documents (proposal, spec, design, tasks, apply-progress, verify-report, resume) from committed content. Why: the maintainer reads these to see what agents are doing (#1198, epic #878). Where: brain/scripts/ui/lib/markdown.mjs (adapter), ui/vendor/marked.esm.js (marked 18.0.14, sha256-pinned, lexer only), change-route.mjs (rev-parse + ls-tree + cat-file reads, 256 KB cap), static/app.js (textContent-only DOM). Learned: marked's Lexer does not merge options (this.options=e||y), so gfm:true must be passed on a fresh literal every call or tables silently vanish; a .md fixture under brain/ becomes a nav document for brain:check, so the XSS fixture is .txt; marked runs out of heap on ~4 MB of deeply nested lists, so the adapter caps input at 512 KB; execFileSync's 1 MiB default maxBuffer would misreport large documents as unreadable.
